protocol.question: At identical 5Circle t5s state and forced action, do history omission and train/deploy continuation change targets or actual outcomes?
protocol.GO: History fix changes held-out continuation regret/outcome in matched train behavior, or target-mode readout consistently improves held-out G in both seeds; eligible only for bounded controlled validation.
protocol.KILL: No actual outcome/target benefit in matched arms, or linear readout fails held-out calibration: stop the tested continuation-only candidate, not claim impossibility.
protocol.root: Replay original saved commands to step20. Force identical archived A0 command once, append observed current frame once. Compare tails starting at the identical resulting true state.
protocol.history_intervention: Only post-root epsilon early-return history omission vs append-every-real-frame. Initial complete deployment prefix identical. Both arms keep repaired terminal bootstrap.
protocol.buffer_contract: ReplayBufferMC push_episode rebuilds continuous real-state windows, including epsilon frames. This intervention changes online actor continuation/actions/labels, NOT buffer frame availability. No buffer or training update is performed.
protocol.train_behavior: phase=train; frozen epsilon=.05, no smoothing/filter/risk according to original phase rules. Same frozen checkpoint. Not a recreation of all past training checkpoints.
protocol.eval_contract: All four arms keep net.eval(), so dropout is disabled. Does NOT reproduce original train-mode actor dropout, mixtures of historical checkpoints, or replay state noise. A controlled frozen continuation contract, not complete original training-behavior reproduction. No new intervention.
protocol.deploy: phase=test; epsilon=0; smoothing=.3, clearance=.2, risk=.8; repaired terminal baseline.
protocol.rng: Per-model/case fixed private NumPy exploration RNG, restored around predict so environment RNG is not consumed by exploration; paired tape same initial seed.
protocol.early_terminal: Cases ending before t5s retained in all16 denominator, marked PRE_ROOT_TERMINAL; no replacement roots.
protocol.budget: 4 models x16 fixed cases x4 arms; <=201 total env steps/episode; 300 full-batch CPU optimizer steps/head; no IL/RL.
protocol.readout: Same true next-window latent256, same train/dev/test cases, old V init, linear257 parameters. MC labels independently for each arm. case%5 split; no dev selection.
protocol.scope: Finite deterministic realizations with one exploration tape, not expected Q or full-learning causal effect.
protocol.sweep_recording: Read-only synchronous min ||d0+t*(executed robot command-human velocity)||-radii over[0,.25]; env current velocity versus actual displacement/.25. Negative clearance counts collision intervals. Includes forced root command; no decision changes.

limitation: Frozen-contract intervention with one exploration realization; not the causal effect of retraining.
